page.overview:
Who is Emir of Benzheen?

Emir of Benzheen is a character in the G.I. Joe RAH comics from Marvel and IDW.

The Emir of Benzheen is an oil baron and ruthless dictator who the US has an uneasy alliance with because of oil. Several Joes were killed trying to protect the Emirate of Benzheen, for the Emir, from a Cobra invasion.
